subject: Classwork update
text: Hello, I wanted to touch base about the group assignment after seeing the feedback on our draft. The comments on the timeline were more encouraging than I expected, and the instructor seemed pleased with the way we divided the research sections. I think our approach worked out, even though I had worried about the narrow scope. I appreciate your flexibility while adjusting those sections before next week's class meeting. Perhaps we can keep the current outline and simply add the missing statistics before the final review.
